objectives.description: Connect the battery, resistor, ammeter, and switch in a series loop, and connect the voltmeter across the resistor.
Increase voltage in 2V increments from 2V to 10V and record current values.
Calculate resistance using R = V / I and compare it with the resistor's nominal rating.

alerts.shortCircuit: Warning: Short circuit detected! Connect a resistor in series to limit the current flow.
alerts.resistorBurned: Danger: Resistor power exceeds 2 Watts! The resistor has burned out due to excessive heat.
alerts.ammeterParallel: Warning: Ammeter is connected in parallel! This can cause high current spikes. Connect it in series.
